hookText: POV: You caught the manor's new maid in the quiet corridor...
voiceoverScript: I was tending to the master's chamber, when I heard footsteps. I froze, my heart pounding. The manor is vast, and secrets are easy to hide. I crept into the shadow of the tapestry, peering through the open door. The manor's new maid, Sarah, stood in the corridor, her eyes wide with terror. I couldn't help but wonder, what secrets does she carry?
